function.name: search_holy_books
function.description: Search content, chapters or authors of holy books. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

book.description: The name of the holy book.

chapter.description: The chapter number, if relevant. Default: 3

content.description: Specific content to look for, if relevant.

message.content:
A **holy book**—also called a sacred text—is a collection of writings considered divine, authoritative, and central to a particular religion or spiritual tradition. These texts often contain teachings, laws, myths, prayers, and moral guidance believed to have been revealed by a deity or inspired by a prophet. Examples include:

| Religion | Holy Book(s) |
|----------|--------------|
| Christianity | Bible (Old Testament & New Testament) |
| Islam | Qur’an |
| Judaism | Tanakh (Hebrew Bible) |
| Hinduism | Vedas, Upanishads, Bhagavad Gita |
| Buddhism | Tripitaka (Pali Canon), Mahayana Sutras |
| Sikhism | Guru Granth Sahib |
| Baha'i Faith | Kitáb-i-Aqdas |

Holy books serve as foundational references for faith, worship, law, and community identity. They can be studied academically, used liturgically, or read privately for personal devotion.
